下部：苍穹无恙第642章既得利益，末路癫狂
第一节特权崩塌，万古基业成空
天道公规彻彻底底铺满三界的那一刻，所有依附旧时代体系生长的权贵修士，终于迎来了无法逆转的末日清算。
没有惊雷炸响，没有天罚降临，可对于九大仙盟残存的顶层强者而言，这无声无息的规则更迭，比万古最狂暴的天劫还要残酷百倍。
虚空钱庄的核心大殿之内，曾经象征三界最高权柄的鎏金玉柱黯淡无光，层层叠叠的功德符文、资本道纹、垄断禁制正在以肉眼可见的速度寸寸崩解、化作飞灰。那些由墨规子亲手镌刻、存续三万载的旧天道代码，在新生平衡规则的冲刷下，脆弱得如同薄纸，没有半点反抗之力。
立于大殿正中的九大仙盟残余高层，人人身形摇晃，面色惨白如纸，浑身仙光层层剥落。
为首的北洲仙盟宗主宗望舒，一身屹立两万载的半仙道基正在极速龟裂。他修行两万三千年，从未真正潜心悟道，毕生修为尽数依托旧天道的资源倾斜、功德暗箱、道果掠夺堆砌而成。在那个阶级固化、规则垄断的黑暗时代，他只需坐稳宗主之位，便能坐享一洲灵脉、收割万千修士道基、兑换无尽天道功德。
三万载的修仙内卷体系，养出了无数他这样的伪强者。
他们不懂大道本源，不通规则真谛，不会本心悟道，唯一精通的，便是利用特权压榨苍生、巩固地位、攫取私利。
“不可能……这绝对不可能！”
宗望舒死死攥紧双拳，指节崩裂渗血，猩红的眼底布满极致的难以置信。他抬手催动毕生本命神通，想要唤出自身凝练万年的功德仙印，可掌心空空如也，曾经一念便可镇压下界万千修士的无上权柄，彻底消散无踪。
他的修为还在跌，从半仙跌落真仙，真仙跌落大罗，大罗跌落金丹。
短短十数息的时间，两万载修行基业烟消云散，昔日俯瞰一洲、言出法随的仙盟霸主，沦为了一个修为微薄、道基残破的普通修士。
“天道不公！我宗家世代镇守北洲，恪守仙盟规制，顺应天道秩序，世代功勋卓著，凭什么一朝修为尽废！”
宗望舒嘶哑的怒吼回荡在死寂的大殿中，裹挟着极致的不甘与怨毒。
身旁其余八位仙盟高层，境遇与他如出一辙。
西洲宗主虞玄龄素来沉稳隐忍，毕生依托功德交易稳固地位，此刻浑身凝练万年的功德金光彻底黯淡，寿元光柱以恐怖的速度飞速流逝，原本乌黑的长发瞬间霜白大半，苍老腐朽的气息席卷全身。
南洲老盟主最为凄惨，他半生依靠收割飞升修士道果进阶，一身道基尽数由万千冤魂道力堆砌而成。新天道因果准则落地，过往所有掠夺罪孽尽数清算，无数道基反噬之力涌入四肢百骸，经脉寸寸爆裂，浑身鲜血淋漓，痛得他浑身痉挛，连站立都无法维持。
无人幸免，无一例外。
所有依托旧规则特权、掠夺苍生利益、垄断修行资源的既得利益者，尽数被新生天道精准清算。

天道从不会偏袒罪恶，旧时代的包容与纵容，不过是规则畸变后的暂时假象。如今平衡归位，善恶归真，所有藏在黑暗底层的罪孽，所有依托不公而生的特权，终究要尽数偿还。
殿外，三界万千修士的议论声层层传来，清晰传入众人耳中，如同无数根细针，狠狠扎进这群末路权贵的心底。
“原来这些高高在上的仙尊，全是靠着压榨我们才堆出来的修为！”
“三万载！我们世代苦修、内卷厮杀、耗尽寿元，到头来只是给他们做嫁衣！”
“新天道公道无私，废黜所有特权，抹平所有阶级，这才是真正的大道苍生！”
一声声感慨、一声声控诉、一声声释然，字字诛心，句句打脸。
这些曾经被众生仰望、敬畏、尊崇的仙界至尊，此刻彻底沦为了三界众生唾弃鄙夷的罪恶之源。
从前，他们高居九天，视底层修士为蝼蚁刍狗，视苍生疾苦为秩序必然；如今，他们跌落尘埃，亲耳聆听万民心声，亲眼见证自己毕生坚守的秩序被彻底推翻，自己世代维系的权柄被彻底清零。
巨大的落差、极致的恐慌、深入骨髓的屈辱，瞬间击溃了众人最后的心理防线。
有人瘫坐在地，呆呆望着自己干枯的手掌，眼神空洞死寂，无法接受万古基业一朝成空的残酷现实；有人捂面痛哭，两万载荣华富贵、至高权势，终究是镜花水月、一场空梦；有人眼底最后一丝理智彻底泯灭，只剩下濒临毁灭的疯狂戾气。
虞玄龄缓缓抬头，望着虚空之上澄澈通透、公正无私的新生天道，嘴角勾起一抹凄厉至极的惨笑。
“我们守了三万年的秩序，护了三万年的天道规制，到头来，反倒成了祸乱苍生的罪人？”
“他们享受安稳岁月，我们承担秩序罪责；他们坐享大道清平，我们背负万世骂名！”
“这所谓的平衡新天，根本就是颠倒黑白、抹杀功勋！”
根深蒂固的特权傲慢，早已刻入他们的神魂本源。他们从未认为自己的掠夺与垄断是罪恶，反而偏执地将墨规子的极端管控视作苍生安稳的唯一途径，将自己的阶级特权视作维系三界秩序的必要牺牲。
在他们扭曲的认知里，众生本就该愚昧卑微、辛苦内卷，本该被权贵掌控、被规则束缚，唯有他们执掌权柄，三界才能维持所谓的安稳。
新生天道打破了这种畸形的平衡，撕碎了他们自欺欺人的借口，也彻底断绝了他们所有的退路与生机。
第二节执念难消，旧权贵疯魔殉道
虚空钱庄大殿的氛围，从最初的绝望死寂，迅速被极致的癫狂戾气彻底笼罩。
这群残存的仙盟高层，历经世代特权熏陶，早已将权柄、地位、特权视作自身神魂的一部分。失去修为、失去权势、失去阶级特权，对他们而言，比身死道消还要痛苦千万倍。

死亡尚可解脱，可这般从云端跌落泥沼、被万民唾弃、被天道清算的结局，让他们无法接受，更无法容忍。
“我不甘心！”

Part 2: The Sky is Safe Chapter 642: Vested interests, terminal madness
Section 1: Privileges collapse and eternal foundation becomes empty
At the moment when the laws of heaven completely covered the three realms, all the powerful monks who grew up relying on the system of the old era finally ushered in the irreversible doomsday reckoning.
There was no thunder, no divine punishment came, but for the remaining top experts of the Nine Immortal Alliances, this silent change of rules was a hundred times more cruel than the most violent natural disaster in all eternity.
In the core hall of the Void Bank, the gilded jade pillars that once symbolized the highest authority in the three realms were dim and dull, and the layers of merit runes, capital patterns, and monopoly restrictions were disintegrating inch by inch and turned into fly ash at a speed visible to the naked eye. Those old codes of heaven, engraved by Mo Guizi himself and lasting for 30,000 years, were as fragile as tissue paper under the erosion of the new rules of balance, without any resistance.
The remaining high-level officials of the Nine Immortal Alliance standing in the middle of the hall were shaking, their faces were as pale as paper, and their bodies were peeling off layers of fairy light.
The leader of the Beizhou Immortal Alliance, Zong Wangshu, has a semi-immortal Taoist foundation that has stood for 20,000 years and is cracking rapidly. He has been practicing for 23,000 years, but has never really devoted himself to enlightenment. His lifelong cultivation has been based on the resources of the old way of heaven, the secret box of merit, and the plundering of the fruits of the way. In that dark age when classes were solidified and rules were monopolized, as long as he held the position of sect leader, he could enjoy a continent's spiritual veins, harvest thousands of monks' foundations, and redeem endless heavenly merits.
Thirty thousand years of involution system of cultivating immortals has produced countless pseudo-powerful people like him.
They do not understand the origin of the Tao, the true meaning of the rules, and do not understand the Tao from their own hearts. The only thing they are proficient in is using their privileges to squeeze the common people, consolidate their status, and seize personal gains.
"Impossible...This is absolutely impossible!"
Zong Wangshu clenched his fists tightly, his knuckles were cracked and bleeding, and his scarlet eyes were full of extreme disbelief. He raised his hand to activate his life-long magical power, trying to summon his immortal seal of merit that had been condensed for thousands of years, but the palm of his hand was empty. The supreme power that could suppress thousands of monks in the lower world with a single thought completely disappeared without a trace.
His cultivation level is still declining, from semi-immortal to true immortal, from true immortal to Daluo, and from Daluo to Jindan.
In just ten breaths, 20,000 years of cultivation foundation disappeared into thin air. The overlord of the Immortal Alliance who once overlooked a continent and followed his words became an ordinary monk with a meager cultivation base and a broken Taoist foundation.
"Heaven is unfair! My clan has guarded Beizhou for generations, strictly abided by the rules of the Immortal Alliance, complied with the order of heaven, and has made outstanding achievements for generations. Why should our cultivation be ruined in one day!"
Zong Wangshu's hoarse roar echoed in the dead silence of the hall, carrying the ultimate unwillingness and resentment.
The other eight senior officials of the Immortal Alliance around him were in the same situation as him.
Xizhou Sect Master Yu Xuanling has always been calm and forbearing, and has relied on merit transactions to stabilize his position throughout his life. At this moment, the golden light of merit that has been condensed for thousands of years is completely dimmed. The longevity beam of light passes at a terrifying speed. Most of his long black hair turns white in an instant, and the aura of aging and decay sweeps across his body.
The old alliance leader of Nanzhou is the most miserable. He has relied on harvesting the Dao Fruit of Ascended Monks for half his life to advance, and his Dao Foundation is made up of the Dao power of thousands of innocent souls. The new code of cause and effect of heaven came into effect, and all past plundering sins were completely liquidated. The counterattack power of countless dao bases poured into his limbs and bones. His meridians exploded inch by inch, and blood dripped all over his body. The pain made his whole body convulse, and he could not even stand.
No one is spared, no exception.
All vested interests who relied on the privileges of the old rules, plundered the interests of the people, and monopolized cultivation resources were accurately liquidated by the new heaven.
Heaven will never favor evil. The tolerance and indulgence of the old era are just temporary illusions after the rules are distorted. Now that balance has been restored, good and evil have returned to their true state, all the sins hidden in the darkness and all the privileges based on injustice must eventually be repaid.
Outside the hall, the discussions of thousands of monks in the three realms could be heard layer by layer, clearly reaching everyone's ears, like countless fine needles, piercing into this group of people.The bottom of the heart of the powerful and powerful.
"It turns out that these high-ranking immortals all gained their cultivation by squeezing us!"
"Thirty thousand years! We have been practicing hard for generations, fighting in internal affairs, and exhausting our lifespan. In the end, we are just making wedding clothes for them!"
"The new way of heaven is fair and selfless, abolishing all privileges and erasing all classes. This is the true path of the great people!"
There were sighs, accusations, and reliefs, every word was heartbreaking, and every sentence was a slap in the face.
These supreme beings in the immortal world who were once looked up to, feared, and respected by all living beings have now completely become the source of evil that is spurned and despised by all living beings in the three realms.
In the past, they were high in the sky, and regarded the monks at the bottom as ants and dogs, and the suffering of the common people as the inevitable necessity of the order; now, they fell into the dust, listened to the voices of the people with their own ears, and witnessed with their own eyes that the order they had adhered to throughout their lives was completely overturned, and the authority they had maintained for generations was completely wiped out.
The huge gap, the ultimate panic, and the bone-deep humiliation instantly defeated everyone's last psychological defense line.
Some people sat paralyzed on the ground, staring blankly at their withered palms, their eyes empty and lifeless, unable to accept the cruel reality that their eternal foundation had been wiped out; some people covered their faces and cried bitterly, knowing that 20,000 years of glory, wealth, and supreme power were ultimately an empty dream; some people had the last trace of reason in their eyes completely wiped out, leaving only the madness and rage on the verge of destruction.
Yu Xuanling slowly raised his head, looking at the clear, transparent, fair and selfless new way of heaven above the void, a sad and sad smile appeared at the corner of his mouth.
"We have kept the order for 30,000 years and protected the laws of heaven for 30,000 years. In the end, we have become the sinners who brought trouble to the common people?"
"They enjoy a peaceful life, and we bear the responsibility for the crime of order; they enjoy a peaceful life, and we bear the infamy for all eternity!"
"This so-called balanced new sky is simply confusing right and wrong and obliterating meritorious deeds!"
The deep-rooted arrogance of privilege has long been engraved in their souls. They have never considered their plunder and monopoly to be evil. Instead, they paranoidly regard Mo Guizi's extreme control as the only way for the stability of the people, and regard their class privileges as a necessary sacrifice to maintain the order of the three realms.
In their distorted cognition, all living beings are supposed to be ignorant, humble, hard-working, and entangled. They are supposed to be controlled by the powerful and bound by rules. Only when they hold power can the so-called stability of the Three Realms be maintained.
The new way of heaven broke this abnormal balance, tore apart their excuses for self-deception, and completely cut off all their retreat and vitality.
Section 2: Obsession is hard to get rid of, and the old dignitaries go crazy and die as martyrs
The atmosphere in the Void Bank Hall, from the initial despair and silence, was quickly completely enveloped by the ultimate madness and violence.
This group of remaining senior members of the Immortal Alliance have been influenced by generations of privileges and have long regarded power, status, and privileges as part of their souls. Losing cultivation, losing power, and losing class privileges are millions of times more painful for them than death.
Death can still be a relief, but the ending of falling from the clouds into the mire, being spurned by all people, and being liquidated by heaven is something they cannot accept, let alone tolerate.
"I'm not willing to give in!"
